subject: Pre-deploy keystore handshake & canary rollback evidence for SIG intake
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <assessor@nimbus-sec.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Dev Team <dev-team@clientcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake - request: pre-deploy keystore handshake + canary rollback artifacts

Kimberly —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of the SIG intake for ClientCorp we need the following artifacts to close the ‘pre-deployment controls’ questions:

1) Keystore / HSM handshake proof (who signed the release and the keystore exchange log for the last production rollout).
2) Canary rollback playbook used during the rollout and the runbook that the on-call follows.
3) CI gating artifacts showing PR approvals and the gate that prevented deployment for one unsafe commit (ideally the commit id and gate output).
4) Evidence of short-lived secret issuance and the steward who requested it (audit trail preferable).

Deadline: we need these uploaded to the shared evidence Drive folder by EOD tomorrow (26 May) to stay on schedule for assessor Q&A next Tuesday. If you have partial items, upload what you can and flag missing pieces.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Alex
Nimbus Security (SIG Assessments)

From: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Mercer <assessor@nimbus-sec.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com, grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com, jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake - request: pre-deploy keystore handshake + canary rollback artifacts

Alex —

Thanks, we can provide this. I'm looping in Lauren (Security Ops), Grace (Platform), and Jordan (Release Eng) to assemble the bundle. Plan:

- Today: upload keystore handshake log and a redacted keystore key-id ledger (keystore-handshake.log, redaction applied to private key material).
- Tomorrow morning: upload the canary rollback playbook (PDF) and the CI gate export for the specific rejection we referenced (ci-gate-export.csv).
- By EOD 26 May: consolidated evidence bundle (evidence-bundle-20270526.zip) with a short manifest describing redactions and retention windows.

Notes / asks: please confirm if you need PR approval screenshots (we can provide the PR page and a separate CSV export) or if the PR UUID + approver list is sufficient. Also, Alex — will you accept the DocuSign link for the SLA exception approval, or do you need a PDF-signed copy?

Attachments (uploaded now):
- keystore-handshake.log [attachment stub]

I'll update the Drive folder and reply with links when everything is in place.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Mercer <assessor@nimbus-sec.com>, kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com, jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com, Dev Team <dev-team@clientcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake - request: pre-deploy keystore handshake + canary rollback artifacts

Alex / team —

Uploading the rest of the artifacts now to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-evidence

Summary of items added (redacted where required):
- canary-rollback-playbook.pdf [attachment stub] — authored by Release Eng, includes triggers, rollback steps, post-rollback verification checks and the communication checklist.
- ci-gate-export.csv [attachment stub] — exported from our gating service showing PR #1427 blocked by the ‘forbidden-secret-detection’ check on 2027-02-18; includes timestamped gate output and the artifact name (commit abc123).
- pr-approvals.csv [attachment stub] — minimal export with PR id, approver usernames, and approval timestamps (no credential data).

Key clarifications:
- Keystore handshake: keystore-handshake.log shows the public key thumbprints exchanged and a signed timestamp from our HSM operator (operator:j.blake). Private key material is redacted; we retain full unredacted logs in our secure vault and can provide them to an accredited auditor on an NDA if required.
- Short-lived secrets: issuing is done via ephemeral-vault with time-to-live 15 minutes for runtime credentials. audit@greenbank.com has previously requested the issuance trail; we've added an example issuance event in ci-gate-export.csv with the requestor listed.

If that's sufficient, we'll wrap into the evidence-bundle and include a manifest that lists redactions and the retention policy. Alex — please confirm if you need the HSM operator signature in PDF (we can produce a signed notarized copy) or if the log with the operator fingerprint suffices.

—Lauren
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com, Alex Mercer <assessor@nimbus-sec.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake - request: pre-deploy keystore handshake + canary rollback artifacts

Alex / all —

Final bundle uploaded: evidence-bundle-20270526.zip [attachment stub]. Contents and notes:
- manifest.txt (plain text) describing each file, redaction rationale, and contact for follow-up.
- keystore-handshake.log (redacted public fingerprint + operator signature)
- canary-rollback-playbook.pdf (final, internal runbook)
- ci-gate-export.csv (gate outputs + sample issuance event)
- pr-approvals.csv (exported from Gerrit)

Operational guarantees:
- Rollback window and canary monitoring: we maintain a 60-minute canary observation window; automated rollback can be triggered after two consecutive anomaly checks or a manual operator sign-off.
- Change approvals: PRs touching release orchestration files require two approvers from the Release Eng roster, and merge is gated by the CI policy; we included one example of a gated rejection.

DocuSign: we initiated an SLA exception sign-off for the demonstrative deployment — link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC1234-SLA-exception. If you need the signed PDF, we will attach it to a follow-up.

Alex — please confirm receipt and whether you'd like the full unredacted keystore logs submitted under NDA. If not, this bundle should satisfy the SIG pre-deploy control checks.

Thanks
Grace O'Connor
Senior Product Infrastructure Engineer (Platform)
